items.source: Used in conjunction with RetryOperations.
items.translation: 与RetryOperations配合使用。

items.source: Defaults to the fully-qualified class name of the implementation class.
items.translation: 默认为实现类的完全限定类名。

items.source: Method to execute and retry if needed.
items.translation: 执行并在必要时重试的方法。

items.source: R - the type of the result
Throwable - if an error occurs during the execution of the operation
items.translation: Throwable - 如果操作执行期间发生错误

items.source: the name of this retryable operation

A unique, logical name for this retryable operation, used to distinguish
between retries for different business operations.
items.translation: 用于区分不同业务操作重试的唯一逻辑名称。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个功能接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
